verses.text: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,

xrefs.text: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.

verses.text: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,

xrefs.text: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.
He who isolates himself pursues selfish desires; he rebels against all sound judgment.
So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
He who has ears, let him hear.
Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

verses.text: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,

xrefs.text: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
Therefore give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people and to discern between good and evil. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”
Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.

verses.text: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,

xrefs.text: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
who long for death that does not come, and search for it like hidden treasure,
With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.

verses.text: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.

xrefs.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD. They will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me with all their heart.
I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”

verses.text: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

xrefs.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
But there is a spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives him understanding.

verses.text: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,

xrefs.text: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
Let no one deceive himself. If any of you thinks he is wise in this age, he should become a fool, so that he may become wise.
From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.

xrefs.text: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.

verses.text: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity— every good path.

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD says: “Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: ‘Where is the good way?’ Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it!’
Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,

verses.text: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.

xrefs.text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
I have not departed from the command of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my daily bread.
I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

verses.text: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,

xrefs.text: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
Do not forsake wisdom, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will guard you.
May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
If the axe is dull and the blade unsharpened, more strength must be exerted, but skill produces success.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.

verses.text: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity,

xrefs.text: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”
To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
“Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
For your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters injustice.

verses.text: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,

xrefs.text: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they do not know what makes them stumble.

If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
The man who strays from the path of understanding will rest in the assembly of the dead.
They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.

verses.text: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,

xrefs.text: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.
The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
What right has My beloved in My house, having carried out so many evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your doom? When you are wicked, then you rejoice.
And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.
Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.

verses.text: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.

xrefs.text: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
The way of a guilty man is crooked, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
His people have acted corruptly toward Him; the blemish on them is not that of His children, but of a perverse and crooked generation.
so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.

verses.text: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words

xrefs.text: And I find more bitter than death the woman who is a snare, whose heart is a net, and whose hands are chains. The man who pleases God escapes her, but the sinner is ensnared.
For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
to keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
that they may keep you from the adulteress, from the stranger with seductive words.
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it.

verses.text: who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

xrefs.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you according to your deeds, since you have despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
Have you not just called to Me, ‘My Father, You are my friend from youth.

Then I passed by and saw you, and you were indeed old enough for love. So I spread My cloak over you and covered your nakedness. I pledged Myself to you, entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine, declares the Lord GOD.
May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth:
Yet you ask, “Why?” It is because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.

verses.text: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.

xrefs.text: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,

But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a double-edged sword.
The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;

verses.text: None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.

xrefs.text: And I find more bitter than death the woman who is a snare, whose heart is a net, and whose hands are chains. The man who pleases God escapes her, but the sinner is ensnared.
So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

I will not punish your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery. For the men themselves go off with prostitutes and offer sacrifices with shrine prostitutes. So a people without understanding will come to ruin.
Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.
Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Neither are you able to do good— you who are accustomed to doing evil.

verses.text: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.

xrefs.text: Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.

This is what the LORD says: “Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: ‘Where is the good way?’ Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it!’
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.

verses.text: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

xrefs.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.
So the LORD blessed Job’s latter days more than his first. He owned 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 yoke of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.

verses.text: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.

xrefs.text: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and multiply, so also it will please Him to annihilate you and destroy you. And you will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.
